# Capsuline

> > Capsuline is a bulk empty capsule supplier for pharmaceutical and nutraceutical manufacturers, offering gelatin and plant-based capsules in multiple sizes with cGMP certification and kosher/halal options.

Capsuline specializes in wholesale empty capsules for the pharmaceutical and dietary supplement industries, providing bulk orders of 50,000+ units. The company offers both traditional gelatin capsules (bovine-derived) and vegetarian alternatives (HPMC/K-CAPS) across multiple sizes with compliance certifications including cGMP, Kosher, and Halal.
